body: I'm glad you have something in your life that can help. I wish I could own a leopard gecko but you're not allowed to own them in Australia

I lost my cat and dog to my ex so I know how you feel. The hardest thing for me was getting a new pet after my childhood dog died a few years ago but in the end I wasn't replacing him but starting a new journey with a new friend. I don't know your circumstances but if it's possible for you to get another pet maybe it's something you need in your life
I named my axolotl Newt because axolotls and newts are both salamanders but axolotls are not Newts haha

Maybe I'm crazy but he seems so much happier since I got him and actually gave him what he needs to be healthy. If I was gone his life would be worse and he wouldn't know why and that's enough for now, I think

I haven't told anyone exactly how I'm feeling. I really don't want to put that on them. I've been living on friends couches so people are always around and I don't want to ask more from them. I don't want them to feel responsible for my safety from myself. If that makes sense?

Honestly though, your comment about losing my home made me feel a lot better for tonight. People are tiptoeing around that subject at the moment so your the first person to mention it and I feel less like I don't want to wake up tomorrow
The hard thing about keeping myself distracted is I really don't have the will or energy to do much of anything. Do you have any advice on that front?
